note: Scripture source: the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, CC BY-SA 4.0), parsed from the ebible mirror's USX (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv), all 66 books, with section headings, notes and the IRV's 15 trailing cross-reference parentheses stripped. Translators looked up every quotation (cited or not) in that verse file and copied the bytes by script.
Translated from the English as the deploy settles it (corrections.settled_chapter_body), so the library's BODY_CORRECTIONS for this slug are already in the source.

Derived by measurement: a row is mined only when the translator reported the quotation verbatim AND the block contains a 30-character run of that verse (or a quoted span of 10+ characters that is a substring of it), compared with quotation marks and punctuation stripped. adapted/self rows and 14 unconfirmed verbatim claims (mostly one-word or short-phrase echoes) are self_rendered. 478 of 591 rows mined.

Conventions: curly quotation marks mirror the English; reader address आप (teaching register, like godliness.hi); the Holy Spirit पवित्र आत्मा, always personal (वह); author name टॉरे (the library's bio and plan card form).

IRV divergences flagged by the translators: Ps 104:30 reads साँस (breath) where Torrey's English has 'your Spirit'; 1 Cor 12:30 has no 'Do all interpret?'; 1 Pet 4:14 lacks a clause Torrey quotes; 2 Cor 13:14 has no Amen. Words the IRV lacks stay outside the quotation marks.
